title: SG-4.3 Confirm Phaser 3.90 game config pixel-art, DPR and fit scaling
summary: Confirm the game config uses pixelArt, roundPixels, device-pixel-ratio and fit scaling valid for Phaser 3.90 with Phaser-mocked tests passing
description: Context: game/frontend/src/phaser/config.ts builds the Phaser config (pixelArt, roundPixels, antialias false, Scale.FIT, CENTER_BOTH) and exports computeZoom(w,h,dpr), which nothing consumes yet. Desired behavior: config uses only 3.90-valid keys, DPR handling is safe, and unit tests run with phaser mocked. Why: crisp pixel art at any device pixel ratio.
acceptance_criteria: Given buildGameConfig is called, When inspected, Then render.pixelArt, render.roundPixels are true and antialias is false
Given buildGameConfig is called, When inspected, Then scale.mode is Scale.FIT with autoCenter CENTER_BOTH and autoRound true
Given computeZoom receives a zero, negative or NaN dpr, When called, Then it returns an integer >= 1
Given phaser is mocked, When the config unit tests run, Then they pass
definition_of_done: All requirements have passing unit tests
